UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user's profile and preferences for Phase 1. Counter and moderation fields (followersCount, followingCount, postsCount, isVerified, isBanned) are read-only from client. Admin roles are handled via Firebase Auth Custom Claims, not a Firestore role field.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

displayName.description: User's full display name (1 to 60 characters).

email.description: User's email address from Auth provider (up to 120 chars).

photoUrl.description: Optional profile avatar URL (up to 500 chars).

language.description: Preferred UI language code ('bn' for Bengali, 'en' for English).

onboardingCompleted.description: Whether the user has completed initial name & unique username onboarding.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UsernameClaim.title: UsernameClaim
UsernameClaim.description: Unique username reservation document in /usernames/{username} written atomically in the same batch/transaction as /users/{userId} (verified via getAfter).

uid.description: UID of the user who claimed this username (must equal request.auth.uid).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the username was claimed (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Phase 1 user profiles. Strictly owner-only read and write in Phase 1.

/usernames/{username}.description: Global unique username registry. Requires atomic batch/transaction with /users/{uid}. Immutable once claimed.
